name: Floor Scrubber Pad
definition: A replaceable nonwoven or specialty floor-contact disc or sheet used with a pad driver; material, color/grade, diameter, thickness, speed, floor finish, chemistry and machine head must be approved together.
includedScope: Cleaning, scrubbing, stripping, polishing and burnishing pads
Disc and rectangular pads for approved scrubber or floor-machine heads
Floor, chemistry, speed and pad-driver compatibility checks
headline: Pad color is a manufacturer system—not a universal aggressiveness standard.
description: This profile maps cleaning, stripping and polishing pad families and turns official evidence into floor, speed, chemistry and machine-fit gates.
metaDescription: Floor scrubber pad colors, materials, sizes, stripping and polishing uses, pad-driver fit and floor compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
